svg.title: Neuropixels mismatch responses
svg.desc: Panel A pairs two matrices over the same 50 frontal, visual, hippocampal and thalamic areas and the same sixteen events: on the left the fraction of units responding to the mismatch relative to their own expected comparison, on the right the mean mismatch-minus-control firing rate. Panel B shows responsive-unit heatmaps plus baseline-subtracted population spike-density functions for one event per context.
svg.text: Left: fraction of units responsive (Q1, uncorrected p < 0.05, |modulation| > 0.1). Right: mismatch minus matched control firing rate.
Areas with ≥10 pooled QC-passing units. Hatched where an area has fewer than 10 tested units for that event.
Q1-responsive QC-passing MUA/SUA units ≥1 Hz, in anatomical order; heatmap color is mismatch minus control SDF spikes/s
Rows are selected on the test, not on the plotted effect. Lower traces show baseline-subtracted mean SDF ±1 SEM across the same units
